quotes.text: ¿Qué es ... del jefe(a) de este hogar?
¿Todas estas personas comparten el mismo gasto para comer?
¿Cuántos hogares o grupos de personas tienen gastos separados para comer contando el de usted?
cuidar o atender sin pago, de manera exclusiva, a niños, ancianos, enfermos o discapacitados? (bañarlos, cambiarlos)

assessments.reasoning:
member_to_member_relationships: False. In Question 7, relationships are recorded strictly relative to the head of household ('¿Qué es ... del jefe(a) de este hogar?'), not member-to-member via a matrix grid or pointer IDs.

extended_ties: False. Question 7 asks for relationship to the head, but no specific response options or categories for extended ties beyond spouse and child (such as grandparents, siblings, non-kin, or same-sex partners) are provided in the supplied instrument text.

multiple_household_criteria: True. Questions 2 and 3 of Section V explicitly define the criterion for separating multiple households within a dwelling as having separate food expenses ('gastos separados para comer').

sub_units: False. The instrument contains no fields, codes, or questions to identify sub-units or secondary family nuclei within a household.

caregiving_relationships: False. Question 9.2 in Section IX measures time spent providing care to children, elderly, sick, or disabled individuals, but does not identify caregiving relationships (who cares for whom).
